outputs.basis: the metric of upstream Verify (isnan(page_rank_[i]) or fabs(page_rank_[i] - cpu_page_rank[i]) > cpu_page_rank[i] / 1000, common/pr_benchmark.cc:119-120, i.e. max |a - c| / c) with the tolerance 1e-5 at 5 iterations, minus the B200 output's own deviation from the CPU reference (a NaN fails). Measured 2026-10-28: legitimate implementations (as for the 500-iteration inputs) <= 4.2e-7; one iteration fewer 6.5e-3, one stale row in the last iteration 4.9e-4, an in-place update >= 1.7e-4, an f16 vector 6.1e-4 fail
